answer: Because the knoll count is verified against the pearl text itself, the umber audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 97 aliases as a result means producing 97 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
